title: Tutor answer (multi-step)
description: Every answer the LLM gives has this shape. It extends Ben's single-step TutorReply in src/tutor/schema.ts: `spoken` stays the same, and `steps` is a list of his action/controlId pairs played in order. The animation plays each step and the voice reads its `say` line.

spoken.description: One or two friendly sentences, said first and shown on screen

found.description: false when the answer isn't in the knowledge files. Then steps is empty and spoken says so honestly.

actionId.description: Action id from games/<game>.json, e.g. place_wall

action.description: Ben's actions. tilt only on sticks, squeeze only on triggers. Clicking a stick (L3/R3) is press on left-stick/right-stick.

hold.description: Keep holding instead of letting go (e.g. aim = squeeze L2 and hold)

say.description: One short spoken line for this step, plain English, under 15 words

jargon.description: Filled when the question used gamer slang
